name: Baidu Comate
name_zh: 百度 Comate 智能代码助手
desc: Baidu coding assistant that plans before it edits
desc_zh: 先出方案再动手的百度编程助手
solves: Code cannot leave the network, and blind generation is not reviewable. Comate writes the spec and the task list first, changes files only after approval, and can run entirely on your own servers.
solves_zh: 代码出不了内网，多数 AI 编程工具直接出局。Comate 先写文档和任务清单，确认后才动文件，整套可部署在自己的服务器上。
best_for: When the code stays inside a regulated network and reviewers want a plan before any edit.
best_for_zh: 代码要留在受管内网，且希望在改动前先看到一份可审的计划。
notes: Forces a Doc-to-Tasks-to-Changes flow instead of blind generation, and supports fully private deployment for regulated teams. 来源：https://www.infoq.cn/article/ONi9RGciXT9EKSAHNcRz 2026-11-25：status active → renamed; superseded_by null → wenxin-fastcode。同一个产品的两个名字：2024-06-28 的 WAVE SUMMIT 上百度宣布 Comate 品牌升级为中文名「文心快码」。改名关系应从旧名指向新名 2026-11-25：name_zh "文心快码" → "百度 Comate 智能代码助手"。旧名档案不应带着新名字；百度云新闻稿对当时的叫法是「百度Comate智能代码助手」 2026-11-25：released 2023-06-06/day → 2023-10-24/day; source https://cloud.baidu.com/news/news_ff716dc2-311e-47af-9de4-799260d5a2bf。原日期 2023-06-06 是邀测日。百度云新闻稿写「今天，百度Comate智能代码助手SaaS版本正式上线…即日起企业和开发者可前往百度Comate官网体验」，页面时间 2023-10-24；同一页写明「自2023年6月6日正式开放邀测起」。申请制邀测不算公开
